purpose: Exercise rights/version, JATS section-language-reference, author-team-role and work-group contracts; no human classifier or population fitting
source: PMC official E-Utilities metadata discovery and OAI-PMH GetRecord
year_reason: One shared calendar year reduces temporal heterogeneity in this structural pilot; it is not a human-origin criterion
target_reason: Two structural examples per declared-type/journal combination; engineering coverage budget, not statistical power or representativeness
candidate_query_template: chi[la] AND "cc by license"[filter] AND "{journal}"[journal] AND 2021[dp] NOT "pmc embargo"[filter]
ordering: Sort complete returned ID list by SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed + | + journal + | + numeric PMCID; IDs are canonical numeric strings
screen_stop: Stop metadata screening when each target type has two accepted items, or the first 20 ranked candidate IDs have been screened. Report underfill rather than extend the frame
eligibility: Official JATS front matter contains exact article-type review-article or research-article and xml:lang zh
Official license references use a CC BY URI, excluding NC/ND/SA variants; preserve any contradictory notice and quarantine if interpretation is materially unclear
PMCID, PMCID-version and DOI are present; none imply immutable content by themselves
Title, abstract and source labels do not indicate an individual patient narrative or case report; ambiguous small-case reports are excluded
Retraction/correction/editorial/letter types are outside this pilot
No model score, prose statistic, linguistic outcome, author-identity guess or claimed pre-LLM human label affects selection
frame_freeze: Write exact private selected-work manifest and its SHA-256 before requesting any full-text pmc records
post_freeze_failures: No replacements. Quarantine identity/license/type changes, access failures, sensitive case narrative, invalid XML or structural violations; report denominator and cause
hash_contract: Save exact HTTP response bytes (compressed when supplied), exact decompressed OAI XML bytes, SHA-256 for each; record HTTP ETag/Last-Modified if supplied; exact extracted article-byte hash plus source IDs/version and OAI datestamp. Do not fabricate source hashes when absent
privacy_storage: All raw XML, author names, per-work IDs/locators, per-span text and selected-work manifest remain outside the repository; publish only aggregate observations, contract, source documentation links and manifest checksum
provenance_states: Production/assistance unknown unless source explicitly discloses it; coauthor bylines are research roles, not individual prose authorship
analysis: Count structural elements and language inheritance; do not assert XML paragraphs are discourse units
Keep front/body/back, abstract/trans-abstract, references, table/figure/quotation/formula/supplement roles separate
Preserve author contrib/name-alternatives/affiliation/correspondence roles; report author-team limitations
Check duplicate work IDs, DOI, exact article-byte hash, and same-work language/version relations; no claim of complete near-duplicate or cross-repository linkage
Test stable offsets/hashes and non-overlapping projected units; no flattening nested XML that double-counts text

known_previewed_exclusions.individual_locators: retained only in private original preregistration
